name: Sankaku Matsuri Vol.1
source:
Triangle fandisc features heroines of popular series "Mahou Senshi Sweet Knights". Summer vacations is chosen as theme, and five stories chosen by fans vote are included.

Also mini-dramas and typing game "Knights hitting!" are included.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
